## Hand-calculation rows (RF at RB; the judged RF at max(DAF, 1.61) is RB / 1.61), minimum over the 21 cases

NOTE: these hand rows are landing_path_a.py on the CAD geometry AS DRAWN. The D-215 / T-068 package (clamshell root block, enlarged saddle, plates, cup / pin geometry; printed masses adopted in T-067) is neither drawn in the CAD nor modelled in landing_path_a.py, so the shoe / root-block / saddle / spar-saddle / cup rows are the pre-package state: their BASELINE column reproduces the T-064r record (for example P12 0.28, P6 0.50 -> 0.47 at 1.64 kg, P11 0.34, P14a 0.32 -> 0.29) and they have been below 1.0 since T-064r. They are not new findings of this task.
